title: Državni praznici i blagdani Republike Hrvatske (1992–2030) — multilingual completos
description: Comprehensive Croatian national public holidays (državni praznici i blagdani) from 1992 (independence and adoption of the post-Yugoslav holiday calendar) through 2030, generated algorithmically from the vacanza/holidays Python library implementation in holidays/countries/croatia.py. Each record carries the holiday name in three vacanza-supported languages: Croatian (hr, native default), English (en_US), and Ukrainian (uk). Covers Nova godina, Sveta tri kralja (Bogojavljenje), Uskrs and Uskrsni ponedjeljak (Catholic Easter), Praznik rada, Dan državnosti (changed from 25 Jun to 30 May per Law NN 13/2020), Tijelovo, Dan antifašističke borbe, Dan domovinske zahvalnosti, Velika Gospa, Dan svih svetih, Dan sjećanja na žrtve Domovinskog rata i Dan sjećanja na žrtvu Vukovara i Škabrnje, Božić, and Sveti Stjepan. Croatia has no subdivisions in vacanza.
